column1: # D1 stability gate: per-arm fits taken off the tail of the fourteen-arm wave so that two
# cards that fell idle carry them concurrently instead of waiting behind one serial lane.
# frozen before any model quantity was read. Each cell's output directory is the same label
# under the same snapshot as its copy in the earlier wave, so whichever queue reaches it
# second records skipped-complete rather than repeating the fit.
